pick.headline: Korean Air flight 858 destroyed by North Korean agents
pick.summary: On November 29, 1987, Korean Air flight 858 exploded over the Andaman Sea, killing all 115 aboard. A bomb had been planted by two North Korean intelligence agents; one, Kim Hyon-hui, survived to confess.
pick.significance: The bombing, aimed at disrupting the 1988 Seoul Olympics, led the United States to put North Korea on its list of state sponsors of terrorism.
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia report of December 1, 1987, listed, under Bahrain, a Tokyo KYODO item quoting a Bahraini official on the suspects in the South Korean jet bombing, the two North Korean agents detained there.
